description:
Adam Cogan is speaking at the Adelaide .NET User Group.

### From Copilot to the Garden of Eden

Move beyond the underwhelming 2023 "Copilot hype" to the 2026 tools that deliver value for developers. Adam cuts through the noise and explores how AI is reshaping the enterprise stack, from Copilot and Cowork to agentic workflows and CLI-based coding.

Agents such as OpenClaw and Hermes are changing how developers automate their day-to-day work. Learn how roles are shifting, which AI assistants are winning, and what an AI-integrated "Garden of Eden" looks like. Leave with a practical roadmap to build, analyze, and automate with confidence.

### Agenda (ACDT)

- 5:30 pm - Arrival, networking, and food
- 5:55 pm - Introductions and news
- 6:00 pm - From Copilot to the Garden of Eden with Adam Cogan
- 7:30 pm - Post-event catch-up at the West Oak Hotel across the road

This is an in-person-only event with strictly limited seating. The organizer recommends Wilson City West Car Park, a two-minute walk from the venue.
